changes: Import DOCX, PPTX and HTML/HTM through a bounded local parser worker
Preserve original bytes across discovery, repair, backup/restore and workspace migration
Require explicit cancellation after file selection and preserve import drafts on outside clicks or Escape
Show extraction limits before confirmation and keep import actions visible on narrow screens

desktop: First entry offers a blank user-authored profile and skippable model setup
Packaged application uses the canonical candle mark
Project introduction, author link and expandable acknowledgements are present in the packaged application
Native window, private application origin, isolated settings, three public materials and sandboxed renderer
Packaged worker parses DOCX, PPTX and HTML without a model key or external resources
Repeated launch returns to the same application window
Embedded reader and Chinese/math PDF export work without an external browser
Window close flushes a pending edit and stops the internal service
Notes and model settings survive repeated restarts; the parent configuration remains untouched
